## TL;DR
RepoOS now guards against huge and build-output files and secrets in WIP checkpoint commits and branch diffs: path and size rules, a bounded secret scan that decompresses gzip, zlib and zstd, a check-gate step, and a pre-commit hook on every branch. This round fixes review pass 5.

## Work and rationale
- Fail-open decode: a gzip member followed by trailing bytes made gunzip throw and the scan silently fall back to raw bytes. `tryGunzip` now parses the gzip header and recovers the deflate stream with `inflateRawSync(..., Z_SYNC_FLUSH)`, keeping partial output. A valid gzip header over a body that still cannot be decoded (and a zstd frame that fails to decode) now reports `scan-incomplete`; bytes that are not a valid gzip header (random binaries with a `1f 8b` pair) stay silent.
- Allowlist over 5 MiB: an allowlisted blob larger than the read cap is re-read up to a 64 MiB hard cap and scanned in overlapping windows (8 KiB overlap), so a secret cannot hide past the first window; beyond the hard cap it reports incomplete. The 6 MiB test now asserts zero violations, and a second test finds a secret past the first 5 MiB window.
- Refusals leave nothing staged: on any planner error, `commitWipCheckpointForRemoteGate` unstages every path the pass staged (chunked), so clean paths and build output past the 500-path expansion cap cannot ride into the next bare commit. Test added.
- Not changed, human-owned: the stale macOS Hub command in `repoos.toml` (review item 4). `just macos-build` now writes to `~/Library/Caches/RepoOS/macos-derived-data` (override `REPOOS_MACOS_DERIVED_DATA`); config never lands with a task, so the one-line `repoos.toml` update is applied on main at sign-off.
- Earlier rounds on the branch stay: blob-only reads, HEAD content scan, bounded inflation, zlib at any offset, rename and deletion handling, bounded directory walk.

## Approaches tried
Windowed scanning with a hard cap instead of streaming `git show` through a pipe, since the guard code is synchronous; the cap is explicit and fails closed beyond it.

## Challenges and blockers
The window scan is raw and per-window decompression; a compressed payload straddling a window boundary is covered only by the raw overlap.

## Key learnings
Every decode path must either scan, or report that it could not, and every refusal path must clean up everything it staged.
